note: Newton County (GA) zoning districts are not published as a public queryable service. The county zoning page offers only the ordinance, overlay district text and PDF maps. The county and City of Covington GIS catalogs list zoning, but it is sold under a GIS pricing schedule, not open. The county's qPublic viewer is parcel-focused. The one city zoning service found (Social Circle, ArcGIS layer Zoning_SocialCircle_Working/FeatureServer/12) is parcel-based and mostly in Walton County; it failed the in-county check (16 of 1546 features in Newton), so it was not submitted.
